bibl.title: Śabdabhedanirūpaṇa
bibl.note: A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.
Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002.

3 different works of the same name (on primary, secondary, and suggestive śabdaśakti) were produced at the behest of Śāhaji by Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and his pupils Nārāyaṇa and Veṅkaṭakṛṣṇa. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 34.

Tanjore Descriptive Catalogue lists Ms 5301 as authored by Rāmabhadramakhin, containing 'two more works with the similar name by different authors'. 5302 is authored by Veṅkaṭakṛṣṇa, and 5303 by Nārāyaṇa.

The 3 authors were encouraged to write independently on śabdaśakti by Śāhaji, with the result that there are three Śabdabhedanirūpaṇas. See Thiruvengadathan, A. Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita and His Works: A Study. Chennai: The Kuppuswami Sastri Research Institute, 2002: p. 8.
